SANDBOX — investigational, NOT FOR CLINICAL USE. Synthetic or public images only. Every response carries `regulatory_status: "investigational"`; production access starts after ARTG inclusion. Clinician review is enforced by the API: /measure, /tissue, /vlm-features and /run require an approval_id from /approve, bound to the image and the final mask.

- **Auth:** `x-api-key: mw_sandbox_…` (or `Authorization: Bearer`). Keys are per organisation, hashed at rest, scoped per module. Mint with `npm run api:key`.
- **Clinician review is enforced:** `/measure`, `/tissue`, `/vlm-features` and `/run` need an `approval_id` from `/approve`, bound to the SHA-256 of the image and of the final mask. A different image or mask is a `403 approval_mismatch`.
- **Every response** carries `request_id`, `api_version`, `engine_version`, `model_versions`, `regulatory_status`; degraded steps add `degraded: true` and `reason`.
- **Errors:** `{ "error": { "code", "message", "request_id" } }`. Codes: `unauthorized`, `forbidden_scope`, `production_unavailable`, `rate_limited` (with `Retry-After`), `invalid_json`, `validation_error`, `approval_required`, `approval_invalid`, `approval_mismatch`, `idempotency_conflict`, `unprocessable`, `internal_error`.
- **Idempotency:** send `Idempotency-Key` on a POST to get the original response back for 24 h.
- **Masks** returned to sandbox keys carry a PNG `tEXt` watermark (`Comment: MendWise sandbox …`). Pixels are untouched.
- Machine-readable: [`/docs/openapi.json`](/docs/openapi.json) or `GET /api/v1/openapi`.

## `POST /api/v1/assessments/segment`

POST /segment — draft wound outline (SAM 3; FUSegNet second opinion on foot wounds; HSV fallback).

Scope: `segment`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base64` | string | yes | JPEG or PNG, base64 or a data URI. Send the SAME bytes to every call for one assessment: approvals bind to their hash. |
| `prompts` | object |  | Clinician prompts from the review screen. Fractional coordinates of the image. |
| `body_zone` | string \| null |  | Body zone id, e.g. foot_left. Decides whether FUSegNet gives a second opinion. |
| `assessment_id` | string |  |  |

## `POST /api/v1/assessments/mask`

POST /mask — rasterise a clinician polygon (fractional) to a PNG mask.

Scope: `segment`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `polygon` | object[] (≤ 400) | yes |  |
| `width` | integer 16–2048 |  |  |
| `height` | integer 16–2048 |  |  |
| `approval` | `"adjusted"` \| `"drawn"` |  |  |
| `assessment_id` | string |  |  |

## `POST /api/v1/assessments/approve`

POST /approve — clinician sign-off of the final mask. Returns approval_id; writes the correction log.

Scope: `approve`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base64` | string | yes | JPEG or PNG, base64 or a data URI. Send the SAME bytes to every call for one assessment: approvals bind to their hash. |
| `assessment_id` | string | yes |  |
| `approval` | `"approved"` \| `"adjusted"` \| `"drawn"` | yes |  |
| `final_mask` | string | yes | Binary PNG mask (white = wound) as a data URI. https URLs are accepted only from fal.media. |
| `ai_mask` | string \| null |  | The model draft, to compute the correction IoU. Null when drawn from scratch. |
| `clinician_id` | string \| null |  | The caller's own opaque clinician identifier. |
| `provider` | `"sam3"` \| `"fusegnet"` \| `"hsv"` \| null |  |  |
| `model` | string \| null |  |  |
| `confidence` | `"high"` \| `"medium"` \| `"low"` \| null |  |  |
| `score` | number 0–1 \| null |  |  |
| `edits` | integer 0–10000 |  |  |
| `taps` | integer 0–10000 |  |  |
| `box_used` | boolean |  |  |
| `ms_to_approve` | integer 0–86400000 |  |  |
| `image_source` | `"public_dataset"` \| `"synthetic"` \| `"consented_demo"` |  |  |
| `body_zone` | string \| null |  | Body zone id, e.g. foot_left. Decides whether FUSegNet gives a second opinion. |
| `monk_tone` | integer 1–10 \| null |  |  |
| `second_opinion` | object \| null |  |  |

## `POST /api/v1/assessments/measure`

POST /measure — area, length, width, perimeter, px/cm, white balance and tissue inside the approved mask.

Scope: `measure` · **requires `approval_id`**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base64` | string | yes | JPEG or PNG, base64 or a data URI. Send the SAME bytes to every call for one assessment: approvals bind to their hash. |
| `mask` | string | yes | Binary PNG mask (white = wound) as a data URI. https URLs are accepted only from fal.media. |
| `approval_id` | string | yes | From POST /approve. Required by every image module. |
| `include_coin_reference` | boolean |  | False when there is no coin in the photo. Default true. |
